observability_triage.rationale: A required slide switch is an actual schematic component and PCB footprint with a switch topology and panel/control nets. Existing reset and boot buttons can be protected as a regression by checking their real components and connectivity. The uncertain count of '2 additional buttons' is not elevated into a target criterion because it is absent from the changed gold path.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The main-board design includes one populated panel slide-switch component with a matching PCB footprint, at least three electrical terminals implementing a real switch pole/throw topology, and a non-floating connection between the intended panel/control nets.

observables.surface: dist/design.kicad_sch and dist/design.kicad_pcb panel slide switch
setup: Build both KiCad artifacts and select the panel slide-switch reference by symbol class and stable field/reference.

expected_observations.subject: slide-switch mandatory terminals with no-connect or no net
slide-switch references missing a PCB footprint

determinism_controls: Classify from KiCad symbol pin topology and library id, not a prose component title.
Join schematic and PCB by reference.

setup: A generic connector is renamed 'switch' but has no switch symbol topology.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The existing reset and boot pushbuttons remain populated, have matching PCB footprints, and each connects its controller input to the intended reference rail through the switch rather than being replaced by the new slide switch.

setup: Resolve reset and boot pushbutton symbols and controller endpoints.

expected_observations.subject: populated reset and boot pushbutton controls
reset/boot controls missing matching PCB footprints
reset/boot controller paths that do not traverse their pushbutton

determinism_controls: Identify controller input nets from actual connectivity.
Respect DNP fields and reject synthetic pinless placeholder components.
